picks.name: iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF
picks.thesis: U.S. spot bitcoin ETF complex just ended a nine-day ~$3.1B inflow streak with a soft outflow day, while October’s Fed meeting (27–28 Oct) and CPI (14 Oct) dominate risk appetite. IBIT remains the most liquid listed vehicle for a tactical BTC sleeve without custody friction; use as a SHORT catalyst play on flow + rates repricing, not a multi-year conviction vehicle (use BTC spot for LONG).
picks.risks: ETF flow reversal; rising real yields; crypto beta to risk-off; sponsor/premium-discount noise.
picks.invalidation: Sustained multi-day net outflows across U.S. spot BTC ETFs alongside a decisive break of recent BTC range lows (monitor CoinGlass/The Block flow dashboards).

picks.name: Ethereum
picks.thesis: Spot ETH ETFs recently flipped from a strong inflow streak to outflows, creating a tactical window if softer inflation data eases October hike odds. ETH remains the deepest smart-contract L1 with liquid spot + ETF wrappers; SHORT horizon leans on flow + macro catalysts rather than protocol roadmap.
picks.risks: ETF outflow persistence; L2 fee compression narrative; correlation with BTC dumps; staking/regulatory headlines.
picks.invalidation: Another full week of combined U.S. spot ETH ETF net outflows with ETH underperforming BTC on a 1-week basis.
picks.price_source: CoinGecko simple/price API (+ Yahoo cross-check available)

picks.name: Solana
picks.thesis: Major liquid L1 with high beta to crypto risk-on into October macro prints. Use only as a sized satellite to BTC/ETH for SHORT tactical exposure; liquidity is deep on major exchanges (CoinGecko tracked).
picks.risks: Higher drawdown vs BTC/ETH; outage/network incident risk; thinner institutional wrapper vs BTC/ETH ETFs.
picks.invalidation: Break of multi-week support with BTC stable (idiosyncratic underperformance >15% vs BTC over 2 weeks) or major network halt headlines from official Solana status channels.
picks.price_source: CoinGecko simple/price API (+ Yahoo cross-check available)

picks.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
picks.thesis: Official IR: Q3 2026 results due ~7:00 a.m. ET Tuesday 13 Oct 2026 with call at 8:30 a.m. ET — a near-dated catalyst into bank NII/credit quality debate as rates stay elevated (RBA recently at 4.60%; Fed decision later in month). Liquid mega-cap financial for a SHORT event-driven sleeve.
picks.risks: Credit costs; deposit betas; trading revenue miss; post-earnings gap risk.
picks.invalidation: Material guidance cut on NII or sharp rise in credit costs on the 13 Oct release vs prior quarter trajectory (read the IR release, not headlines alone).

picks.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
picks.thesis: Next report clustered late October (calendars cite ~27–28 Oct) alongside FOMC — a high-beta AI/ads print after a Q2 miss left a lower bar. Liquid mega-cap for SHORT catalyst trading; size for gap risk.
picks.risks: Ad guidance miss; AI capex skepticism; regulatory; calendar date variance across vendors.
picks.invalidation: Confirm exact date via Meta IR closer to print; thesis voids if report slips past early November without a new confirmed date, or if pre-announcement warns on ads.

picks.name: Microsoft Corporation
picks.thesis: FY2026 IR results: revenue $331.8B (+18%), operating income $155.2B, GAAP NI $133.7B, diluted EPS $17.95. Cloud/AI capex cycle remains the structural bid even as rates stay sticky. Our illustrative 5y scenario table (skills/models) shows base-case earnings-power upside if mid-teens growth persists — MEDIUM horizon to let Azure/AI monetization compound past October macro noise.
picks.risks: Capex ROI skepticism; competition; multiple compression if real yields stay elevated.
picks.invalidation: Two consecutive quarters of Intelligent Cloud growth decelerating sharply below mid-teens without offsetting margin expansion (check future IR releases).

picks.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A
picks.thesis: Berkshire Q2 2026 13F (filed ~14 Aug 2026) showed a large add to Alphabet (GOOGL/GOOG), with reportable portfolio ~$299.25B. Search/YouTube/Cloud cash engine plus AI distribution is a MEDIUM-quality compounder with fresh mega-manager sponsorship — useful diversification vs pure semis.
picks.risks: Antitrust remedies; Search disruption from AI answers; ad cyclicality; 13F is lagged.
picks.invalidation: Sustained Search revenue decline in consecutive 10-Qs or adverse final antitrust remedy that structurally caps Chrome/Search distribution (watch DOJ case outcomes / 8-Ks).

picks.name: Equinix, Inc.
picks.thesis: Listed data-center platform exposed to AI/cloud interconnection demand called out in Oct 2026 AU/global digital-infra commentary. Liquid large-cap way to own power/space scarcity without single-tenant hyperscale idiosyncratic risk. Fundamentals deep-dive limited by EDGAR block — treat as theme sleeve with Med/Low filing confidence.
picks.risks: Rate-sensitive REIT-like multiple; power availability; customer concentration; incomplete filing verify from this box.
picks.invalidation: Two quarters of deteriorating bookings/utilization commentary on earnings calls or equity raise at punitive terms.

picks.name: NVIDIA Corporation
picks.thesis: Verified growth machine: FY2026 revenue ~$215.9B / NI ~$120.1B (secondary 10-K snapshot); Q2 (ended 26 Jul 2026) revenue $96.2B vs $46.7B prior-year quarter (10-Q table excerpt). MEDIUM horizon to ride AI compute demand while acknowledging SOXX’s weak Q3 and valuation/“power-hungry chip” skepticism. Size below MSFT given multiple risk.
picks.risks: Export controls; customer concentration; multiple derating; competing ASIC/custom silicon.
picks.invalidation: Quarterly revenue decline QoQ (ex-seasonality) or data-center gross margin collapse disclosed in next 10-Q/earnings 8-K.

picks.name: Newmont Corporation
picks.thesis: Liquid gold major as a MEDIUM inflation/geopolitical hedge while RBA cash rate sits at 4.60% (Sep 2026 hike) and global energy/geopolitics remain choppy. Diversifies the board away from pure tech/crypto beta.
picks.risks: Gold price drawdown; cost inflation at mines; jurisdictional risk; opportunity cost if real yields spike.
picks.invalidation: Sustained break in gold’s medium-term uptrend with rising real yields (monitor real 10y) plus company guidance cut on AISC.

picks.name: ASML Holding N.V.
picks.thesis: EUV lithography bottleneck for advanced nodes — structural LONG pick on AI/semicap cycle despite near-term SOXX volatility. Liquid ADR; thesis is multi-year capacity/tool demand, not October trading.
picks.risks: Export controls to China; order cyclicality; EUR/USD; customer capex pauses.
picks.invalidation: Multi-quarter booked backlog collapse or credible competing EUV alternative reaching HVM (monitor ASML order/bookings releases).

picks.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company
picks.thesis: Foundry backbone for leading-edge AI accelerators — LONG structural compounder paired with ASML. Liquid ADR; geopolitics is the permanent risk premium.
picks.risks: Taiwan geopolitics; customer concentration (NVDA/Apple ecosystem); capex intensity; FX.
picks.invalidation: Sustained utilization collapse in advanced nodes or material escalation risk that impairs fab ops (company disclosures / credible government advisories).

picks.name: Bitcoin
picks.thesis: Multi-year monetary/network asset with U.S. spot ETF plumbing now mature; October flow noise is SHORT/MEDIUM, but LONG thesis is structural adoption + scarcity. Prefer spot (or IBIT for brokerage convenience) with small core size given volatility.
picks.risks: Drawdowns >50% historically possible; regulation; ETF flow regimes; opportunity cost vs equities in high real-rate regimes.
picks.invalidation: Structural ban or sustained ETF AUM collapse with loss of institutional access rails (not a single down week).

picks.name: Apple Inc.
picks.thesis: Berkshire’s largest 13F line (~$66B / ~22% of reportable book in Q2 2026) anchors a LONG quality compounder with fortress balance sheet and services mix. Lower AI-capex beta than NVDA; suitable multi-year core.
picks.risks: China demand; regulatory App Store; innovation cadence; rich absolute multiple.
picks.invalidation: Services growth turning negative YoY for two consecutive quarters without buyback/capital-return offset thesis change.

picks.name: BHP Group Limited
picks.thesis: Liquid diversified miner (NYSE ADR / dual-listed heritage) for LONG exposure to copper/iron ore and energy-transition materials alongside AU macro. Diversifies tech/crypto-heavy board; commodity cycles require patience.
picks.risks: China steel demand; commodity price cycles; operational incidents; AUD/USD.
picks.invalidation: Multi-year copper/iron price regime break with company cutting growth capex and dividends simultaneously (read BHP results releases).
